name: waterlens
description: WaterLens monorepo — React frontend, FastAPI modular-monolith backend, shared contracts.

scripts.deps:relock: npm install && cd services/backend && uv lock
scripts.dev:api: cd services/backend && uv run uvicorn waterlens.api.asgi:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.dev:worker: cd services/backend && uv run python -m waterlens.worker.main
scripts.seed: cd services/backend && uv run python -m waterlens.cli.seed
scripts.sources: cd services/backend && uv run python -m waterlens.cli.sources
scripts.coverage-matrix: cd services/backend && uv run python -m waterlens.cli.coverage_matrix ../../docs/data-readiness.md
scripts.intervention-catalogue: cd services/backend && uv run python -m waterlens.cli.intervention_catalogue ../../docs/domain/interventions.catalogue.json
scripts.contracts: npm run contracts:export && npm run contracts:gen
scripts.contracts:export: cd services/backend && uv run python -m waterlens.api.export_openapi ../../packages/contracts/openapi.json && uv run python -m waterlens.api.export_graphql ../../packages/contracts/schema.graphql
scripts.contracts:gen: npm -w packages/contracts run generate && npm -w apps/web run codegen
scripts.lint:py: cd services/backend && uv run ruff check .
scripts.typecheck: npm -w packages/contracts run typecheck && npm -w apps/web run typecheck
scripts.typecheck:py: cd services/backend && uv run mypy src
scripts.validate:domain: cd services/backend && uv run pytest tests/domain
scripts.test: npm run test:web && npm run test:py
scripts.test:emulator: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-waterlens "npm run test:emulator:py && npm run test:emulator:web"
scripts.test:emulator:py: cd services/backend && WL_REQUIRE_AUTH_EMULATOR=1 uv run pytest -m emulator
scripts.test:e2e:emulator: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-waterlens "WL_REQUIRE_AUTH_EMULATOR=1 WL_E2E_API=1 npm run test:e2e"
scripts.build: npm -w packages/contracts run build && npm -w apps/web run build
